subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should OpenClaw standardize hook `HOOK.md` metadata on a direct-regular-file requirement with a 1 MiB maximum across installation and workspace discovery?
rationale: The implementation fixes the allocation bug cleanly, but the chosen numeric limit and no-symlink policy intentionally narrow accepted hook package layouts and are not established by current documentation.

options.title: Approve the shared boundary
options.body: Adopt the 1 MiB direct-regular-file rule across both hook ingestion paths and merge once required checks clear.

options.title: Revise the metadata contract
options.body: Choose a different size or symlink policy and update both related PRs, tests, errors, and proof consistently.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared boundary
recommendation.body: Adopt the 1 MiB direct-regular-file rule across both hook ingestion paths and merge once required checks clear.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly maintained the unified hook-install and security boundary affected by this choice.
